objects.name: Analytic 1661
objects.description: For Android, detect Match Legitimate Name or Location from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: PackageInstaller.install() writes binary to device storage for impersonating app — install event is the enrollment of impersonating app]; File Metadata via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: app package_name distance <= $NameDistanceThreshold$ from $KnownAppCatalog$ entry]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
